metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Alf Agenda
records.biography_en: In The Executive Tangle, Alf Agenda takes the role of chancellor. “We'll start with item zero.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short agenda stack with six visible unmarked color tabs.

records.name: Nora Seal
records.biography_en: In The Executive Tangle, Nora Seal takes the role of president. “It is now official enough.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: single oversized blank state seal with an abstract star, held by a small handle.

records.name: Wes Quoteclip
records.biography_en: In The Executive Tangle, Wes Quoteclip takes the role of government spokesperson. “That sentence ends here.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny cluster of two microphones and a short blank quote card.

records.name: Faye Whipcount
records.biography_en: In The Executive Tangle, Faye Whipcount takes the role of party leader. “One bead has reservations.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small wooden tally frame with big sliding beads.

records.name: Cobb Backup
records.biography_en: In The Executive Tangle, Cobb Backup takes the role of vice chancellor. “I'm ready if the first plan sits down.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two stacked blank folders with one much smaller spare pencil.

records.name: Ned Amendment
records.biography_en: In The Executive Tangle, Ned Amendment takes the role of opposition leader. “I have a small amendment.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short oversized pencil and a plain paper marked with one orange zigzag.
